Sunday 18 October 2026, recap and to-dos

Morning
Went to the market on Rue Saint-Denis with Julie. Bought apples, two bunches of kale and a block of old cheddar. The cheddar was too expensive, so I'll check the other shop next time.

Julie said the bike shop on Mont-Royal can fix the rear derailleur on Thursday if I drop it off before noon. I need to call them first to confirm the slot.

Afternoon
Finished the first draft of the route planner README. The traffic caching section still needs an example with a real response payload. Mark said the retry logic was too clever. I agreed to simplify it before the Wednesday review.

Note to self: the staging server certificate expires on 2 November. Renew it before then, not on the day.

Evening
Dinner at Maman's place. Her neighbour, Mr. Tremblay, is moving to Quebec City in December. I offered to help with the move on the 6th if he needs a second pair of hands.

Admin
Renewed the car insurance online. The premium is 1,120 dollars for the year, paid with the Visa ending in 4417.
My health card number is RAMP 1234 5678 90. Keep it safe, but do not store it anywhere.
I'm allergic to shellfish, so remember that for restaurants.

Groceries for the week
Oat milk, two lemons, baby spinach, a dozen eggs, basmati rice, dish soap, and dark roast coffee beans from the bulk store.

Plans for next week
